content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Default
content_blocks.text: This Notice of Eviction is given pursuant to the terms of the Lease Agreement dated May 15, 2024, between the Landlord and the Tenant.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Cause_of_Eviction
content_blocks.text: The Tenant has failed to pay rent in the amount of $1,200 on June 1, 2024, as required by the Lease Agreement.
